notes.title: Change log
notes.content: - Even bigger GamePlay, new world look and added difficulty. New enemies, the Demons. Much stronger than other enemies ... Enemies can spawn with assault rifles. The player can now switch weapons and use assault rifles. Debug of the escalation system where the character is facing the wrong way. Debug the system to restart the level. Additional translations in English. An apocalyptic atmosphere now present. The player can now use a flashlight already present in their inventory. The enemies are more careful and dangerous. Also more violent and active.
